property_summary: For every call to setL1BlockValues, the reference contract always stores the provided _batcherHash into batcherHash (c.batcherHash() == _batcherHash); the mutant that assigns batcherHash = _hash can cause c.batcherHash() != _batcherHash for some inputs.
change_summary: Assign an incorrect value to batcherHash by swapping the two bytes32 parameters: set batcherHash = _hash instead of _batcherHash.
